description: This file provides implementations of the functions gitbasename and gitdirname, which are custom versions of the standard basename and dirname functions, adapted for specific handling in the Git codebase. The functions manipulate file path strings, handling POSIX and DOS drive prefixes, directory separators, and special cases such as root directories.

methods.name: char * gitbasename(char * path)
methods.description: Extracts the base name from a file path, handling edge cases such as DOS drive prefixes and empty paths.

methods.name: char * gitdirname(char * path)
methods.description: Extracts the directory name from a file path, managing trailing slashes, drive prefixes, and root directory edge cases.
